entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who bonds with treefolk hosts to planeswalk, green-aligned and secondarily red; she dies bonding with Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: One of Wrenn's treefolk hosts, from Kessig; a fully grown tree who is torn apart by compleated Nissa.

entities.name: Six
entities.description: A treefolk host of Wrenn from Kessig, left to live out his days as an ordinary oak.

entities.name: Eight
entities.description: The name Wrenn gives to Realmbreaker after bonding with it.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: An artifact on New Phyrexia that Wrenn bonds with and names Eight.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who meets Wrenn on Innistrad, recruits her against the Phyrexians and is later recovered by her; he plants her acorn.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns to New Phyrexia to help allies and brings Wrenn to Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Wrenn and Seven helped defend Urza's Tower; she later appears compleated.

entities.name: Compleated Nissa Revane
entities.description: The Phyrexian-compleated version of Nissa who stops the group and tears Seven apart.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A Mirran ally who guides the group to Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: An ally who with Koth brings the group to Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Vivien
entities.description: A planeswalker who took refuge on Dominaria with Wrenn.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: A planeswalker whose cabin on Dominaria sheltered the group.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A character who helped recover Teferi after the battle at Urza's Tower.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped recover Teferi after the battle.

entities.name: One
entities.description: The first tree host Wrenn bonded with on her homeworld.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Wrenn meets Teferi.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Region of Innistrad said to have the finest trees in the multiverse; source of Four, Six and Seven.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the planeswalkers gather against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Tower on Dominaria holding the Temporal Anchor, defended against Phyrexians.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: A device held in Urza's Tower with a stasis coffin that held Teferi.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane where Realmbreaker is located and which is swapped with Zhalfir.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Plane whose phasing Wrenn promised to help undo; swapped with New Phyrexia's location.

entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: Plane where Wrenn and Teferi meet again.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Place the group visited before settling in Urza's Tower.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where the Pyrewood Gearhulk was designed as a tribute to Wrenn.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: A tree Wrenn planned to merge with in order to retrieve Teferi.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders the planeswalkers fight.

entities.name: Pyrewood Gearhulk
entities.description: A gearhulk on Avishkar designed as a tribute to Wrenn.

events.summary: Wrenn's spark ignites when a forest fire threatens her sisters; she contains the fire within herself and must share it with a tree.
events.quote: Wrenn's spark ignited when a forest fire threatened the lives of her sisters.

events.summary: Wrenn finds her first host, One, on her homeworld, which lets her planeswalk.
events.quote: Wrenn found her first (named by her One ) host on her homeworld.

events.summary: On Innistrad, after leaving Six as an oak, Wrenn seeks a new host and is intercepted by Teferi, who recognizes her as a planeswalker.
Wrenn grants Teferi insight into metamagic so he can see and undo his corrupted time spell; her sapling has gathered all the time it could contain.
events.quote: Wrenn's sapling had gathered all the time it could contain.

events.summary: Wrenn meets a fully grown Seven and promises Teferi to help undo Zhalfir's phasing after showing Seven the multiverse.
events.quote: Wrenn met a now fully grown Seven .

events.summary: Teferi recruits Wrenn on Cridhe to fight the Phyrexians; the group gathers on Dominaria and settles in Urza's Tower.
events.quote: Wrenn was recruited by Teferi to join the fight against the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Wrenn and Seven help Nissa Revane fend off Phyrexians attacking Urza's Tower and the Temporal Anchor, then help recover Teferi.
events.quote: Wrenn and Seven helped Nissa Revane fend off the second line of Phyrexians attacking the tower

events.summary: Wrenn does not join the strike force on New Phyrexia and takes refuge on Dominaria with Vivien, Chandra and Liliana.
events.quote: Wrenn wasn't part of the planeswalker strike force that set out to destroy Realmbreaker on New Phyrexia .

events.summary: Chandra decides to return to New Phyrexia; Wrenn joins her and proposes merging with the Invasion Tree to retrieve Teferi.
events.quote: Wrenn, who had stayed silent, joined her

events.summary: Chandra, Wrenn and Seven meet Koth and Urabrask on New Phyrexia and are led to Realmbreaker.
events.quote: Traveling to New Phyrexia, Chandra, Wrenn, and Seven met with Koth and Urabrask

events.summary: Compleated Nissa Revane stops the group and tears Seven apart limb from limb.
events.quote: who tore Seven apart limb from limb.

events.summary: Chandra, Koth and the remaining Mirrans carry Wrenn to Realmbreaker.
Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker, naming it Eight; together they locate Zhalfir and Teferi and swap New Phyrexia's location with Zhalfir.
events.quote: Wrenn was able to bond with Realmbreaker, whom she named Eight.

events.summary: The strain makes the fire within Wrenn burn bright, killing her and turning her into an ashen statue.
events.quote: killing the dryad and causing her form to turn into an ashen statue.

events.summary: Teferi finds a single acorn after Wrenn's sacrifice and plants it on a hill on Zhalfir, where it sprouts quickly.

relations.note: She helps him undo his time spell and promises to help undo Zhalfir's phasing.
relations.quote: In gratitude for Teferi's help, she promised him to help undo Zhalfir 's phasing

relations.note: Tore Seven apart on New Phyrexia.
relations.quote: who tore Seven apart limb from limb.

relations.note: Joins Chandra's return to New Phyrexia.
relations.quote: Wrenn, who had stayed silent, joined her

relations.note: Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker and names it Eight.
relations.quote: Wrenn was able to bond with Realmbreaker, whom she named Eight.

relations.note: Seven is one of her tree hosts, treated as an ally.
relations.quote: She treats her hosts as allies, refusing to see them as tools or as mere means to an end.
